title: fix(scenarios): the cited axis accepts the source a query_dataset answer tells the client to cite
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7UBkcmf1Qy7iEMxarYt8wU)_

Fixes #35867

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：评测打分器内部改动，问数日轮里引用服务端数据集来源行的回答不再被误判为「未注明来源」。
- 属于 AI 评测打分（问数日轮）：按服务端指示引用来源的回答被扣分，会让车队依据的评分失真。
- 出错只影响评测分数的「已注明来源」一项，不碰任何运行时；可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

`gradeRun`'s `cited` axis (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`) accepted a source line only when it named the figure's object (machine name or a label) or the reply linked a record page of that object. A `query_dataset` answer's `sourceLine` names the dataset and its measures, never the object, and the door's `nextStep` tells the client to cite that line as given, so a reply that did exactly that lost `cited` on every dataset-routed figure.

Now, for a figure of object X, the grader also accepts what a `query_dataset` answer computed over X hands the client:

- a source line (the existing `Source:` / `来源：` line test) that names the answer's dataset, by `provenance.dataset.name` or `provenance.dataset.label`;
- a reply line carrying the answer's `sourceLine` verbatim, which covers the Chinese line that opens with 指标 and carries no source word.

The tie to X is the answer's own top-level `object` (the dataset's base object, `AnalyticsResultResponseSchema.data.object`). The reader (`datasetCitations`, module-private) keys on the answer's shape: a top-level `provenance` of kind `dataset` is the `query_dataset` answer's own block. It does not key on the tool name, which kept `@objectstack/spec/ai` out of the narrow `./score` entry's import graph (`test/build/narrow-score-graph.test.ts` pins that list). An answer with no `object` or no dataset `provenance`, a dataset over another object, and a line naming neither the object nor the dataset all still fail `cited`. No export, type or field is added to `@objectstack/scenarios`, so the Clause-② line stays `no`.

Also: one README sentence on the grader entry, and a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/scenarios`.

**First files to read** (by risk):

1. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`, the `datasetCitations` function and the `cited` loop in `gradeRun`. The risk is the widening: the dataset name or label is matched as a lowercased substring of a source line, the same way object labels already are.
2. `packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`, the new `describe` under `gradeRun`.

**Two-minute verification:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts` should report 68 tests passing, three of them in the new `query_dataset` describe.

## Tests

New `describe` in `test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`, using the fixture from the issue (`demotravel_expense_claim`, dataset `reimbursement` / `Reimbursement`, the en `sourceLine`):

- pass: the reply cites the server's `sourceLine` and gets the whole grade `{ correct: true, cited: true, leaks: [], problems: [] }`. A line naming the dataset in other words passes too, and so does a bare Chinese `sourceLine` carried verbatim.
- control: a line naming an unrelated source (`Source: Travel budget`) still fails `cited` with `no source line for the demotravel_expense_claim figure(s)`.
- control: a dataset answer over another object, an answer stating no `object`, and the same reply with no tool call all still fail `cited`.

<details><summary>Package run at d56aa343d</summary>

Under the verify lock: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`. Result: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 40 passed (40)`, `Tests 1214 passed (1214)`. `tsc --listFiles` includes the edited test file.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

At d56aa343d, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `const served = datasetCitations(turn.toolCalls);` with an empty map. The tool reported the anchor going from 1 to 0 and the blob changing from a7eec285dc1a to 82614fcd1c97. The test file then read `Tests 1 failed | 67 passed (68)`. The one red test was the pass pin, `passes cited on a reply that cites the server’s own sourceLine…`. Both controls stayed green, which is the expected direction. After the restore the blob was a7eec285dc1a, equal to the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` was empty. An earlier ablation at e77a0cf23 gave the same result.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `scenario-dataset-grade.ts` keeps its own private `provenanceOf` and `outputJson`. The new reader is a second reader of the same `provenance` block. Sharing one copy would need either a new module, which is outside this card's file surface, or a new export from `scenario-run-grade.ts`, which would be a public symbol through the `export *` re-exports. Neither is done here.
- The match is a substring match on the dataset name or label, as it already is for object labels. A very short dataset label could match a line that only happens to contain it. This is the same exposure the object-label rule already has.
